office_does: The county clerk keeps the records, files and accounts of the Superior Court that Garfield County shares with Asotin and Columbia counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk Marie Gormsen, first elected in 2018, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Garfield County Clerk since 2018, running unopposed; she submitted no statement to the voters' guide.
highlights: Born and raised in Garfield County [S6]
